listing_price_shape.name: listing_price_shape
listing_price_shape.value: ("listings"."price_type" = 'FREE' and "listings"."exact_price" is null and "listings"."minimum_price" is null and "listings"."maximum_price" is null) or ("listings"."price_type" = 'FIXED' and "listings"."exact_price" is not null and "listings"."minimum_price" is null and "listings"."maximum_price" is null) or ("listings"."price_type" = 'RANGE' and "listings"."exact_price" is null and "listings"."minimum_price" is not null and "listings"."maximum_price" is not null and "listings"."minimum_price" <= "listings"."maximum_price")

reports_dedupe_idx.name: reports_dedupe_idx
reports_dedupe_idx.where: "reports"."reporter_id" is not null and "reports"."target_id" is not null and "reports"."status" in ('OPEN','INVESTIGATING')
